purpose: Reviewed semantic contracts for existing WHO and SPF annual source categories; no raw fact rewriting or release-gate changes

conditions: Public-health use under the WHO dataset terms; no commercial promotion, implied endorsement, de-anonymisation or misleading representation
Acknowledge WHO, original dataset/indicator title, year, access date and reporting country; retain the original source URL and labels
Keep original source values, records and missing-value states intact; source-to-concept mappings are separate interpretation metadata, not modifications to the original dataset
Other alterations/modifications require prior WHO written authorization; third-party-credited components require their own review
Do not label WHO dataset terms as unrestricted CC BY 4.0 or substitute a generic WHO publication licence
Attribute Santé publique France, original dataset URL and extraction date
Preserve reported territory, definition changes, totals and strata
